name: scriptora
description: Scriptora Screenplay Studio & Narrative Intelligence Engine

scripts.build:frontend: npm --prefix frontend run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.copyFileSync('frontend/dist/index.html','index.html'); fs.copyFileSync('frontend/dist/404.html','404.html'); ['favicon.png','apple-touch-icon.png','launcher-icon.png','manifest.webmanifest','manifest.json'].forEach(f=>{if(fs.existsSync('frontend/dist/'+f)) fs.copyFileSync('frontend/dist/'+f,f);}); if(fs.existsSync('frontend/dist/icons')) fs.cpSync('frontend/dist/icons','icons',{recursive:true}); fs.cpSync('frontend/dist/assets','assets',{recursive:true});"
